data.description: Process task list and separate into completed and pending arrays
data.script: const completed = []; const pending = []; processData.taskList.forEach(task => { if (processData.completedStatuses.includes(task.status?.toLowerCase())) { completed.push(task); } else { pending.push(task); } }); return { completedTasks: completed, pendingTasks: pending, completedCount: completed.length, pendingCount: pending.length };

data.description: Review the automated task categorization and make adjustments if needed

data.label: Notify Completion
data.description: Send notification about task categorization results
data.subject: Task Categorization Complete
data.message: Tasks have been separated: {{processData.completedCount}} completed, {{processData.pendingCount}} pending

data.label: Generate Summary
data.description: Create summary report of categorization results
data.script: return { summary: { totalTasks: processData.taskList.length, completed: processData.completedCount, pending: processData.pendingCount, completionRate: ((processData.completedCount / processData.taskList.length) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }, completedTasks: processData.completedTasks, pendingTasks: processData.pendingTasks };

data.label: End
data.description: Task separation complete
